title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Funding Fee Refund Hardship Limit by Disability Compensation Combined Rating
content:
On a VA Home Loan Guaranty funding fee refund, the share of the fee returned that may be applied against a home loan guaranty debt is limited for hardship according to the combined rating of the veteran's Disability Compensation award.

## Hardship limit

| The veteran's Disability Compensation award | Hardship limit on the share |
|---|---|
| Combined rating of at least 50 percent | 50 percent |
| Combined rating below 50 percent but at least 10 percent | 75 percent |
| Otherwise (the veteran holds no compensation award) | Not limited (100 percent) |

The rating thresholds are 50 (the high hardship rating) and 10 (the low hardship rating); a rating equal to a threshold falls on that threshold's row.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical awards)

| Combined rating on the award | Hardship limit |
|---|---|
| 100 | 50 |
| 50 | 50 |
| 40 | 75 |
| 10 | 75 |
| No award | 100 |

## Basis questions

**Which rating counts?** The combined rating of the veteran's Disability Compensation award as the award record shows it.

**What does the limit act on?** On the share of the fee returned that may be applied against the debt: the share is further limited to the hardship limit percentage.
